route: Balanced line input -> channel fader -> hard-left pan -> main L sum -> main master -> balanced XLR output
eq: Bypassed; residual loading from unused EQ/low-cut branches omitted
output_connection: pin2 minus pin3, each leg loaded by 10 kohm to ground
heldout_description: 0-3 s Talking Hedz filtered bass at explicit -12.0412 dB before desk; 3-6 s independent percussion; 6-8 s independent bass; 8-9 s recovery. No training or selection on these targets. 9-18 s: independent onset bursts, ramps, hot percussion and hot recovery.
omissions: EQ and low-cut branch residual loads
solver: Gear, reltol 1e-4, abstol 1e-12, vntol 1e-7, itl4 10; original filesource, 4x maximum timestep and uniform storage
record_state: Independent circuit operating point and 0.5 seconds of zero input per record. Training and inference reset recurrent state at the same record boundaries.
refinement_initialization: Copied parent checkpoint (32-unit interim on the 60-second set), then 3500 of 6000 steps on this pair interrupted by a memory kill; resumed from that best checkpoint for the remaining 2500 steps
extension: The 60-second study stimulus keeps its records; each split gains the same length again of onset bursts stepping from below to above the clip point into silence, 1-second dB ramps through the clip point and back, hot recovery bursts and hot percussion, none above 0.8 units, every burst with a 5 ms attack and the new material rolled off above 12 kHz. Old records 14-19 keep their circuit renders at their new positions 28-30 and 34-36.
